Question_text: FBM is a boat building business. It has 100 skilled employees. The Operations Director is concerned that FBM holds a high level of inventory. She is also concerned that the business is starting to experience diseconomies of scale. The Finance Director has been asked to analyse FBM's cost and output data. An extract is shown in Table 1.1.

The second column provides the corresponding data values: '$5000', '$600000', and '300' respectively.

Question_text: ADN is a food retailer. It has 5 shops and 300 full-time employees. All ADN's employees receive off-the-job training. ADN has a tall hierarchical structure. Managers have a narrow span of control and all use an autocratic leadership style. ADN's directors are planning to expand the business and cannot decide whether it is better for a business to use internal growth or external growth.
Unit: UNIT 2: People in business, UNIT 1: Understanding business activity
Topic: 2.2 Organisation and management, 2.3 Recruitment, selection and training of employees, 1.3 Enterprise, business growth and size
Sub_topic: Hierarchical structures: levels, span of control, chain of command, chain of tall/short
Features of leadership: autocratic, democratic, laissez-faire
Benefits, limitations: part-time vs full-time employees
Benefits, limitations: induction, on-the-job, off-the-job training
Ways to grow: internal/external

Parts.part_text: Define 'span of control'.
Define 'autocratic leadership style'.
Outline two benefits to ADN of having full-time employees.
Explain one benefit and one limitation to ADN of using off-the-job training.
Do you think it is better for a business to use internal growth or external growth when planning to expand? Justify your answer.

CFG has developed a new chocolate bar. The Marketing Manager plans to use skimming as its pricing method, and retailers as its distribution channel for the new product. He knows there are many legal controls over marketing that might affect a business.

Sustainable development, business contribution
